#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Differential harness: run the reference executable and the Node port with the
# same argv, compare stdout, stderr and exit code byte for byte.
# The PyInstaller notice carries the pid, so that one line is normalised.
EXE=/workspace/dataset/test19_executable
JS="node /output/test19.mjs"
pass=0; fail=0
declare -a FAILED

norm() { sed -E 's/^\[PYI-[0-9]+:ERROR\]/[PYI-PID:ERROR]/'; }

check() {
  "$EXE" "$@" >/tmp/d_eo 2>/tmp/d_ee; local rc_e=$?
  $JS "$@" >/tmp/d_jo 2>/tmp/d_je; local rc_j=$?
  norm </tmp/d_ee >/tmp/d_een; norm </tmp/d_je >/tmp/d_jen
  if cmp -s /tmp/d_eo /tmp/d_jo && cmp -s /tmp/d_een /tmp/d_jen && [ "$rc_e" = "$rc_j" ]; then
    pass=$((pass+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1)); FAILED+=("$*")
    echo "MISMATCH: $(printf '%q ' "$@")"
    [ "$rc_e" != "$rc_j" ] && echo "  rc: py=$rc_e js=$rc_j"
    cmp -s /tmp/d_eo /tmp/d_jo || { echo "  --- stdout py"; cat -A /tmp/d_eo; echo "  --- stdout js"; cat -A /tmp/d_jo; }
    cmp -s /tmp/d_een /tmp/d_jen || { echo "  --- stderr py"; cat -A /tmp/d_een; echo "  --- stderr js"; cat -A /tmp/d_jen; }
  fi
}

# merged-stream ordering (stdout buffering is observable here)
check_merged() {
  "$EXE" "$@" >/tmp/d_em 2>&1; local rc_e=$?
  $JS "$@" >/tmp/d_jm 2>&1; local rc_j=$?
  norm </tmp/d_em >/tmp/d_emn; norm </tmp/d_jm >/tmp/d_jmn
  if cmp -s /tmp/d_emn /tmp/d_jmn && [ "$rc_e" = "$rc_j" ]; then
    pass=$((pass+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1)); FAILED+=("MERGED: $*")
    echo "MERGED MISMATCH: $(printf '%q ' "$@")"
    echo "  --- py"; cat -A /tmp/d_emn; echo "  --- js"; cat -A /tmp/d_jmn
  fi
}
